entries.appliesTo: Tennessee Advisory Commission on Intergovernmental Relations (TACIR)

sources.program: § 1(a) — 'The Tennessee Advisory Commission on Intergovernmental Relations (TACIR) shall conduct a study and produce a report on artificial intelligence.'

flags: study-only bill: one-time TACIR study and report to governor and speakers due no later than January 31, 2027 (§ 1(c)); no ongoing compliance duty fits the standard duty vocabulary
study scope includes chatbot emotional-support/mental-health risks and dangerous prompts (suicide/violent-crime encouragement) but imposes no operator obligations (§ 1(b)(4)-(5))
